first_model: V2 full_plus_line; foreign term999 unscaled; q_i from 12 pinned historical periods with high hinge
observed_finishes: 1-3 uniquely ordered from historic actual race results
conditional_actual_first_and_second: P(3rd=k | first=i, second=j), with j != i and k != i,j
equation: P(k third|i first,j second)=q_k^delta exp(D_pos(i,j,k)+D_role(k)) / sum_{h != i,j} q_h^delta exp(D_pos(i,j,h)+D_role(h))

position_definitions.ahead_of_both: Third candidate in same predicted line as first and second and ahead of both in predicted order
position_definitions.between_first_second: Third candidate in shared line of first and second, positioned strictly between them
position_definitions.behind_both: Third candidate in shared line of first and second, after both in predicted order
position_definitions.ahead_of_first: First and second differ in line; third candidate first line, ahead of first
position_definitions.immediately_behind_first: First and second differ in line; third immediately after first in first's predicted line
position_definitions.further_behind_first: First and second differ in line; third at least two positions behind first
position_definitions.ahead_of_second: First and second differ in line; third candidate second line, ahead of second
position_definitions.immediately_behind_second: First and second differ in line; third immediately after second in second's predicted line
position_definitions.further_behind_second: First and second differ in line; third at least two positions behind second
position_definitions.neither_line: Third candidate in line other than lines containing first and second

model_selection.selection: All-data MLE for discovery and BIC; supported by chronological comparison with coefficients estimated on 6393 prior races and scored on 7688 later races

inference_rule: Use pre-race first_win q_i and second conditional P(j|i) to assign every ordered distinct triple P(i first, j second, k third) = q_i P(j|i) P(k|i,j). Do not supply actual first or second when inferring.
warning: Statistical conditional 3rd accuracy with observed first-second known is not equivalent to an unconditional 3連単 hit rate.
In-sample all-14081 coefficients are law discovery, not unobserved prospective evaluation.
Chronological evaluation dates have been previously inspected in other research, not virgin.
Source racecard predeadline snapshots are not certified.
No ticket odds or prices, no expected value, no profit evidence.
